info.title: AI Interview Preparation Platform API
info.description: Backend API for the AI Interview Preparation Platform for Engineering Students

get.description: Returns a 200 OK status if the application process is running.
Returns a 200 OK status if the application is ready to accept traffic. Returns 503 if unavailable.

post.description: Registers a new user. Returns a session if auto-confirm is enabled, otherwise returns a pending verification status.
Authenticates a user with email and password, returning an access token and setting a secure HttpOnly refresh cookie.
Exchanges a valid refresh cookie for a new access token.
Logs out the user and clears the session cookie.

get.description: Retrieves the authenticated user's profile information.
Retrieves the canonical profile of the currently authenticated active user.

200.description: Successful response containing the user profile.

Cache-Control.description: Directives for caching mechanisms in both requests and responses.

patch.description: Partially updates the authenticated user's profile. Rejects unknown or protected fields. Omitted fields remain unchanged.

requestBody.description: The partial profile data to update.

200.description: Successful response containing the updated user profile.

Cache-Control.description: Directives for caching mechanisms in both requests and responses.

delete.summary: Deactivate and soft-delete current user account
delete.description: Soft-deletes the authenticated user's account, sets status to `deleted`, revokes active sessions, and clears the refresh cookie. Existing access JWT may remain valid until expiration. Requires `Idempotency-Key` header.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique key (max 255 chars) to prevent duplicate deactivation execution.

Cache-Control.description: Directives for caching mechanisms in both requests and responses.

Set-Cookie.description: Sets expired refresh cookie to clear it.

get.description: Retrieves the canonical preferences of the currently authenticated active user.

Cache-Control.description: Directives for caching mechanisms in both requests and responses.

patch.description: Partially updates the authenticated user's preferences. Rejects unknown fields. Omitted fields remain unchanged.

requestBody.description: The partial preferences data to update.

200.description: Successful response containing the updated user preferences.

post.description: Creates a new taxonomy item. Follows strict idempotency. Returns stored response body and skips audit log on identical-key replay.

patch.description: Updates an existing taxonomy item. Ensures replay safety with no duplicate mutation or audit logs.

post.description: Archives a taxonomy item by setting is_active to false. Safely avoids duplicate audits on identical-key replays.
Restores a taxonomy item by setting is_active to true. Safely avoids duplicate audits on identical-key replays.

BadRequest.description: Bad Request - The request was invalid or could not be served.

Unauthorized.description: Unauthorized - Authentication is required and has failed or has not yet been provided.

Forbidden.description: Forbidden - The request was a valid request, but the server is refusing to respond to it. The user might be logged in but does not have the necessary permissions for the resource.

NotFound.description: Not Found - The requested resource could not be found.

Conflict.description: Conflict - The request could not be completed due to a conflict with the current state of the resource.

TooManyRequests.description: Too Many Requests - The user has sent too many requests in a given amount of time.

Retry-After.description: The number of seconds to wait before making a new request.

RateLimit-Limit.description: The maximum number of requests allowed in the current window.

RateLimit-Remaining.description: The number of requests remaining in the current window.

RateLimit-Reset.description: The time at which the current window resets, in UTC epoch seconds.

example.message: Too many requests, please try again later.

InternalServerError.description: Internal Server Error - The server encountered an unexpected condition that prevented it from fulfilling the request.

ServiceUnavailable.description: Service Unavailable - The server is currently unable to handle the request due to a temporary overload or scheduled maintenance.

Retry-After.description: The number of seconds to wait before making a new request.

UnsupportedMediaType.description: Unsupported Media Type - The request format is not supported (e.g. non-JSON payload).

ValidationError.description: Unprocessable Entity - The request payload failed schema validation.

RegistrationSuccess.description: Successful registration. May return a session or pending verification.

Set-Cookie.description: The HttpOnly refresh session cookie, if authenticated.

LoginSuccess.description: Successful login. Returns an authenticated session.

LogoutSuccess.description: Successfully logged out. Clears the refresh cookie.

ReadinessSuccess.description: The application is ready to receive traffic.

ReadinessServiceUnavailable.description: The application is not ready to receive traffic.

QuestionForbidden.description: Access is forbidden. Requires Admin role.

QuestionNotFound.description: The requested question or resource was not found.

QuestionValidationError.description: Validation error (e.g. invalid request body or missing idempotency key).

QuestionConflict.description: Resource conflict (e.g. concurrent state modification, duplicate, or idempotency conflict).
